questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter-series.

N_M_N_ _MANNA_A_
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence:N_M_N_ _MANNA_A_ 

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

**Option 1) AANAMN** → N __**A**__ M **__A__** N / __**N**__ __**A**__ M A N / N A __**M**__ A **__N__**

Here, 'NAMAN' followed a pattern.

Option 2) ANNMMA → N __**A**__ M __**N**__ N / __**N**__ __**M**__ M A N / N A __**M**__ A __**A**__

Option 2) ANAMAA → N **__A__** M **__N__** N / __**A**__ __**M**__ M A N / N A __**A**__ A __**A**__

Option 4) ANNANM → N __**A**__ M __**N**__ N / **__N__** __**A**__ M A N / N A __**N**__ A __**M**__

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
‘Q + R’ means ‘Q is the father of R’

‘Q – R’ means ‘Q is the wife of R’

‘Q × R’ means ‘Q is the brother of R’

‘Q ÷ R’ means ‘Q is the daughter of R’

If ‘S ÷ Q + M × P − K’, then how is Q related to K?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Wife
 Brother
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: S ÷ Q + M × P − K

It means: S is the daughter of Q, Q is the father of M, M is the brother of P, and P is the wife of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eeaac17004292fb710b2cc0f08cd3bcbfa2e8ce2050198fdbee9575457d97069.png] 

So, Q is the 'Father-in-Law' of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some gates are ways.

II. All ways are routes.

III. No route is a door.

**Conclusions:**

I. No door is a way.

II. Some gates are routes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given:

I. Some gates are ways.

II. All ways are routes.

III. No route is a door.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5676265ba5e67b1d862747020570cc681f6d415bcccfb1a9fe26f6f8fade140.png] 

**CONCLUSIONS:**

I. No door is a way - **True (**Because, all ways are routes so that no door is a way).

II. Some gates are routes - **True (**Because, those parts of gates which is ways is also routes).

Thus, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘LASER’ is written as ‘80’ and ‘WHITE’ is written as ‘70’. How will ‘GLOVES’ be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Sum of the place value of all opposite letters of word = Code of the word.

 ‘LASER’ is written as ‘80’

Opposites of "LASER" is "OZHVI"

⇒ 15 + 26 + 8 + 22 + 9 = 80.

 ‘WHITE’ is written as ‘70’.

Opposites of "WHITE" is "DSRGV".

⇒ 4 + 19 + 18 + 7 + 22 = 70.

Similarly, ‘GLOVES’ be written as,

Opposite of " GLOVES" is "TOLEVH"

⇒ 20 + 15 + 12 + 5 + 22 + 8 = 82

Thus, **‘GLOVES’ be written as '82'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option "3".**

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Finger

2. Elbow

3. Wrist

4. Nail

5. Palm
questions.solution:
The correct arrangement considering the representation of the the structure of the human arm and hand. would be:

4. Nail (Hard covering at the tip of the finger)

1. Finger (Digits at the end of the hand)

5. Palm (Central part of the hand)

3. Wrist (Joint connecting the hand to the forearm)

2. Elbow (Joint connecting the forearm to the upper arm)

Hence, "**4, 1, 5, 3, 2**" is the correct answer.
